描述_EN: as well as being well-designed and featuring artwork from a number of artists, it has considerable depth and complexity. historically, many games are about violent victory by taking something over, with the emphasis being on the aggressor. spirit island flips that narrative, asking players to be the natives protecting their land, therefore shifting the power. it is overtly political, with the fantasy-cum-alternate history theme firmly framing the european invaders as an oppressive force, intent on the exploitation of resources and environmental ruin. spirit island is an interesting game within the canon of co-operative board games. this positions it within an important and growing group of games with stories that explore politics, histories, experiences and beliefs.
描述_ZN: 不仅设计精良，而且有许多艺术家的作品，它有相当的深度和复杂性。 从历史上看，许多游戏是关于通过占领某些东西取得暴力胜利的，重点是在侵略者身上。 精神岛》翻转了这种叙述方式，要求玩家成为保护他们土地的土著人，因此转移了权力。 它是公开的政治性的，幻想兼替代历史的主题坚定地将欧洲入侵者作为一种压迫性的力量，意图剥削资源和破坏环境。 在合作式棋盘游戏的典范中，《精神岛》是一个有趣的游戏。 这使它处于一个重要的、不断增长的游戏群体中，这些游戏的故事探索政治、历史、经验和信仰。
